statement: These are review conditions, not a compliance result. Nothing here asserts WCAG, accessibility, or legal conformance.

checks.name: semantic_structure
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: Headings, landmarks, lists and tables carry real structure, not visual approximation.

checks.name: state_communication
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: Every state change is conveyed in text and semantics, never by colour, position, sound, or motion alone.

checks.name: error_identification
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: Errors are identified in text, associated with their control, and describe the correction.

checks.name: focus_order
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: Focus order follows the reading order of the surface and never traps the learner.

checks.name: keyboard_operation
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: Every interactive element is reachable and operable without a pointer.

checks.name: touch_target_size
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: Interactive targets are at least 48 by 48 CSS pixels where a touch target applies.

checks.name: visible_focus
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: A visible focus indicator is present on every focusable element.

checks.name: contrast
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: Text and meaningful non-text contrast is examined against the intended background.

checks.name: text_scaling_200
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: Content remains usable and unclipped at 200 percent text scaling.

checks.name: zoom
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: Page zoom does not cause loss of content or function.

checks.name: reduced_motion
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: A reduced-motion preference is honoured and no essential meaning is motion-only.

checks.name: audio_alternative
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: Audio and synthetic speech have an equitable non-audio route.

checks.name: speech_alternative
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: Where speech is not the construct being assessed, a typed or deterministic route exists.

checks.name: transcript_or_caption
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: Transcripts or captions are examined where recorded or synthetic audio carries meaning.

checks.name: plain_language
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: Learner-facing copy is plain, non-punitive, and understandable at the stated level.

checks.name: cognitive_load
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: The number of simultaneous demands on the learner is examined.

checks.name: time_limits
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: No essential task depends on a time limit the learner cannot extend.

checks.name: rtl_layout
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: Arabic renders in logical order with correctly isolated mixed-direction content.

checks.name: expansion
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: Longer translations do not clip, truncate, or change meaning.

checks.name: viewport_320x568
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: The narrowest supported viewport is examined.

checks.name: viewport_390x844
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: The reference viewport is examined.

checks.name: orientation
checks.journeyReference: MARZI-021 learner-facing objective, completion and mastery copy
checks.expectedEvidence: Portrait and landscape are both examined; neither is locked without justification.

knownIssues.summary: Arabic at 320x568 with 200% text can overflow.
